lines.1: Om. May Agni and Vishnu, equally pleased, augment our prayer together with hymns of praise.
lines.2: Come, you two, with brilliance and with vigor.
lines.3: Vigor be mine, and impulse be mine,
lines.4: effort be mine, and undertaking be mine,
lines.5: insight be mine, and resolve be mine,
lines.6: tone of voice be mine, and praise be mine,
lines.7: renown be mine, and revelation be mine,
lines.8: light be mine, and the heavenly world be mine,
lines.9: the outbreath be mine, and the inbreath be mine,
lines.10: the diffused breath be mine, and the vital breath be mine,
lines.11: consciousness be mine, and what is studied be mine,
lines.12: speech be mine, and mind be mine,
lines.13: sight be mine, and hearing be mine,
lines.14: skill be mine, and strength be mine,
lines.15: vitality be mine, and the power to endure be mine,
lines.16: lifespan be mine, and (a full life reaching) old age be mine,
lines.17: the self be mine, and the body be mine,
lines.18: shelter be mine, and armor be mine, and limbs be mine, and bones be mine,
lines.19: and joints be mine, and the bodily frame be mine.
lines.20: Supremacy be mine, and sovereignty be mine,
lines.21: wrath be mine, and splendor be mine, and strength be mine, and vital force be mine,
lines.22: victory be mine, and greatness be mine,
lines.23: expansiveness be mine, and breadth be mine,
lines.24: eminence be mine, and length (of days) be mine,
lines.25: growth attained be mine, and (continuing) increase be mine,
lines.26: truth be mine, and faith be mine,
lines.27: the (moving) world be mine, and wealth be mine,
lines.28: mastery be mine, and brilliance be mine,
lines.29: play be mine, and joy be mine,
lines.30: what is (already) born be mine, and what is yet to be born be mine,
lines.31: the well-spoken word be mine, and the good deed be mine,
lines.32: what is acquired be mine, and what is yet to be known be mine,
lines.33: what has come to be be mine, and what is to come be mine,
lines.34: an easy path be mine, and a good road be mine,
lines.35: prosperity attained be mine, and (continuing) prosperity be mine,
lines.36: what is well-ordered be mine, and orderliness be mine,
lines.37: understanding be mine, and good judgment be mine.
lines.38: Peace be mine, and happiness be mine,
lines.39: what is dear be mine, and the granting of desire be mine, and desire itself be mine,
lines.40: good-heartedness be mine, and auspiciousness be mine,
lines.41: excellence be mine, and increasing wealth be mine,
lines.42: fame be mine, and good fortune be mine, and riches be mine,
lines.43: the restrainer be mine, and the sustainer be mine,
lines.44: security be mine, and steadfastness be mine,
lines.45: the whole world be mine, and greatness be mine,
lines.46: understanding be mine, and the faculty of knowing be mine,
lines.47: the impeller be mine, and the offspring be mine,
lines.48: the plough be mine, and rest be mine,
lines.49: cosmic order be mine, and immortality be mine, and freedom from disease be mine, and freedom from illness be mine,
lines.50: the means of living be mine, and long life be mine, and freedom from enemies be mine, and fearlessness be mine,
lines.51: an easy path be mine, and a good resting-place be mine,
lines.52: a good dawn be mine, and a good day be mine.
lines.53: Nourishment be mine, and pleasant, truthful speech be mine,
lines.54: milk be mine, and its essence be mine,
lines.55: ghee be mine, and honey be mine,
lines.56: food shared together be mine, and drink shared together be mine,
lines.57: tilled land be mine, and rain be mine,
lines.58: the power to conquer be mine, and what sprouts from the earth be mine,
lines.59: wealth be mine, and riches be mine,
lines.60: prosperity be mine, and growth in prosperity be mine,
lines.61: what is far-reaching be mine, and what is abundant be mine,
lines.62: plenty be mine, and increase be mine,
lines.63: fullness be mine, and greater fullness be mine, and inexhaustibility be mine, and good crops be mine, and food be mine, and unfailing grain be mine,
lines.64: rice be mine, and barley be mine,
lines.65: black gram be mine, and sesame be mine,
lines.66: green gram be mine, and small beans be mine,
lines.67: wheat be mine, and lentils be mine,
lines.68: millet be mine, and fine grain be mine,
lines.69: dark millet be mine, and wild rice be mine.
lines.70: Stone be mine, and clay be mine,
lines.71: mountains be mine, and hills be mine,
lines.72: sand be mine, and trees be mine,
lines.73: gold be mine, and iron be mine,
lines.74: lead be mine, and tin be mine,
lines.75: bronze be mine, and copper be mine, and fire be mine,
lines.76: water be mine, and creepers be mine, and herbs be mine,
lines.77: what ripens through cultivation be mine, and what ripens without cultivation be mine,
lines.78: may my domestic animals, and the wild ones too, be made fit through the sacrifice,
lines.79: wealth be mine, and the acquiring of wealth be mine,
lines.80: prosperity be mine, and well-being be mine,
lines.81: treasure be mine, and dwelling be mine,
lines.82: ritual work be mine, and the power (to perform it) be mine, and its purpose be mine,
lines.83: the setting-forth be mine, and the going be mine, and the attaining be mine.
lines.84: Agni be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.85: Soma be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.86: Savitr be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.87: Sarasvati be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.88: Pushan be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.89: Brihaspati be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.90: Mitra be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.91: Varuna be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.92: Tvashtr be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.93: Dhatr be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.94: Vishnu be mine, and Indra be mine, and the two Ashvins be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.95: the Maruts be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.96: all the gods be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.97: the earth be mine, and Indra be mine, and the mid-region be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.98: the sky be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.99: the quarters of space be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.100: the (cosmic) summit be mine, and Indra be mine,
lines.101: Prajapati be mine, and Indra be mine.
lines.102: The soma-stalk be mine, and its filament be mine, and the unassailable one be mine, and the presiding lord be mine,
lines.103: the silently-pressed soma be mine, and the inward-restraining cup be mine,
lines.104: the cup for Indra-Vayu be mine, and the cup for Mitra-Varuna be mine,
lines.105: the cup for the Ashvins be mine, and the assistant's offering be mine,
lines.106: the clear soma be mine, and the mixed soma be mine,
lines.107: the first-fruits offering be mine, and the offering to all gods be mine,
lines.108: the fixed oblation be mine, and the offering to Vaishvanara be mine,
lines.109: the seasonal soma-cups be mine, and the additional soma-cups be mine,
lines.110: the cup for Indra-Agni be mine, and the all-gods cup be mine,
lines.111: the litany of the Maruts be mine, and the great Indra's portion be mine,
lines.112: the Aditya's portion be mine, and the Savitr's portion be mine,
lines.113: the Sarasvati's portion be mine, and the Pushan's portion be mine,
lines.114: the offering with the wives of the gods be mine, and the offering yoked with tawny steeds be mine.
lines.115: The kindling wood be mine, and the sacred grass be mine,
lines.116: the altar be mine, and the fire-altars be mine,
lines.117: the ladles be mine, and the cups be mine,
lines.118: the pressing stones be mine, and the sacrificial posts be mine,
lines.119: the pressing-hollows be mine, and the two pressing-boards be mine,
lines.120: the trough-vessel be mine, and the vessels for Vayu be mine,
lines.121: the vessel of the purified offering be mine, and the pouring-vessel be mine,
lines.122: the Agnidh priest's fire be mine, and the shed for the oblation be mine,
lines.123: the sacrificial huts be mine, and the assembly-hall be mine, and the rice-cakes be mine,
lines.124: the cooking-vessels be mine, and the closing rite be mine, and the exclamation of blessing be mine.
lines.125: Fire be mine, and the heated oblation be mine, and the sun-vessel be mine,
lines.126: the sun be mine, and the life-breath be mine, and the horse-sacrifice be mine,
lines.127: the earth be mine, and the boundless (mother) be mine, and the bound (finite) be mine,
lines.128: the sky be mine, and the powerful chant-fingers and the directions be mine,
lines.129: may the Rik verse be fashioned through the sacrifice, and be mine,
lines.130: the Saman chant be mine, and the hymn of praise be mine,
lines.131: the Yajus formula be mine, and the consecration be mine,
lines.132: austerity be mine, and the (proper) season be mine,
lines.133: the vow be mine, and, through the rain of day and night, the Brihat and Rathantara chants be mine,
lines.134: may these be fashioned through the sacrifice.
lines.135: The calves in the womb be mine, and the calves be mine,
lines.136: the three-season ewe be mine, and the three-season ewe-lamb be mine,
lines.137: the yearling bull be mine, and the yearling cow be mine,
lines.138: the five-season bull be mine, and the five-season cow be mine,
lines.139: the three-year bull be mine, and the three-year cow be mine,
lines.140: the four-year bull be mine, and the four-year cow be mine,
lines.141: the mature bull be mine, and the mature cow be mine,
lines.142: the young bull be mine, and the barren cow be mine,
lines.143: the bull be mine, and the pregnant cow be mine, and the draught-ox be mine,
lines.144: may the milch-cow be mine, and may my lifespan be fashioned through the sacrifice,
lines.145: may the outbreath be fashioned through the sacrifice, may the inbreath be fashioned through the sacrifice,
lines.146: may the diffused breath be fashioned through the sacrifice,
lines.147: may sight be fashioned through the sacrifice, may hearing be fashioned through the sacrifice,
lines.148: may the mind be fashioned through the sacrifice,
lines.149: may speech be fashioned through the sacrifice, may the self be fashioned through the sacrifice,
lines.150: may the sacrifice itself be fashioned through the sacrifice.
lines.151: One be mine, and three be mine,
lines.152: five be mine, and seven be mine,
lines.153: nine be mine, and eleven be mine,
lines.154: thirteen be mine, and fifteen be mine,
lines.155: seventeen be mine, and nineteen be mine,
lines.156: twenty-one be mine, and twenty-three be mine,
lines.157: twenty-five be mine, and twenty-seven be mine,
lines.158: twenty-nine be mine, and thirty-one be mine,
lines.159: thirty-three be mine, and four be mine, and eight be mine,
lines.160: twelve be mine, and sixteen be mine,
lines.161: twenty be mine, and twenty-four be mine, and twenty-eight be mine,
lines.162: thirty-two be mine, and thirty-six be mine,
lines.163: forty be mine, and forty-four be mine, and forty-eight be mine,
lines.164: and vigor, and impulse, and what is born after, be mine,
lines.165: and resolve, and light, and the (cosmic) summit, be mine,
lines.166: and the far-reaching one, the one who goes to the end, and the last, be mine,
lines.167: and the lord of beings, and the world, and the sovereign, be mine.
lines.168: Om. May Ida, the invocation of the gods, Manu, the leader of the sacrifice, and Brihaspati, proclaim these hymns of praise;
lines.169: may all the gods, speakers of well-uttered hymns, be pleased. O Earth, my mother, do not harm me.
lines.170: Sweet thoughts I shall think, sweet words I shall speak,
lines.171: sweet I shall utter, sweet I shall proclaim;
lines.172: may I offer to the gods a speech full of sweetness, worthy to be heard,
lines.173: and sweet also to my fellow men.
lines.174: May the gods favor me for my glory; may the ancestors approve.
